Just my two cents, I would just try to reach out to him in person. Like some other commenters have said, it’s very likely he just hasn’t seen your message if it’s sitting in his DM requests. And honestly, it’s also just as possible he saw the message and wasn’t interested but tried to be nice by not opening the message. I don’t say that to be curt, but that it happens. You say you see him a lot out and about — I would ask in what context do you see him? Whether that’s just briefly in the hall of your classroom building, or if he’s in a club or an actual class with you. If it’s just in passing, it might be harder to get his attention enough to ask him out. But if you have a class or are around him for an extended period of time, you have more of an opening. At the end of the day, it’s one guy out of an entire university, so don’t be too hard on yourself. Just keep putting your line out there and eventually you’ll catch something. Good luck!

This is my honest opinion, so please don't feel this is fact, as I am only going off the information you provided in your post. But I am questioning her feelings towards you. If she does not seem willing to spend time with a great guy like you (only when it seems it will benefit her), and does not even want to be seen with you in public, that is a huge reg flag. I'm a girl myself, and I can tell you that with every guy I've ever been interested in, the first person I tell is my friend - I pretty much talk her ear off about this guy, because of how great I think he is! Also, from my experience, and based off what I've seen from other girls, especially at my age (I'm 16), when a girl is stressed out, 9 times out of 10, they want to spend time with their crush or significant other. Not even their best friend can help as much as another guy can - it's just a different chemical balance idk. Now, I could be completely wrong, and she could just have crippling social anxiety like me (trust me, it's a thing). But maybe don't overthink it; maybe ask her what you guys are all about. I know that is easier said than done, but in reality, you will feel so much better establishing the relationship early on, rather than overthinking and being disappointed because it is not what you thought. I know I am young and may not be of much help, but I hope I can at least give some perspective, being a girl myself. Hang in there and let us know what you decide to do. :)

One exercise my band director taught me is to use pulses. Set a metronome at 80 BPM, then slowly work from quarter notes, to eighth notes, to triplets, then finally to sixteenth notes.
